av.label: Audio/video: per recording, per minute, free minutes
av.value: shall not exceed the cost thereof to the public agency — media actual cost + hourly salary for formatting/programming necessary to provide the copy as requested; no per-minute or per-recording rate; no redaction charge
av.unit: actual cost (per recording = media cost + permitted programming/formatting salary; per-minute: none; free minutes: n/a)
av.authority: Conn. Gen. Stat. § 1-212(b), § 1-211(a); FOIC FIC 2022-0176 (Collins v. City of New London, Apr. 12, 2023) ¶¶ 37-42; § 1-212(a) (transcriptions at cost)
av.notes: Audio/video recordings are computer-stored records; the only chargeable components are those in § 1-212(b): media at actual cost, hourly salary for genuine formatting/programming, outside-service cost, contractor computer-time. commercial.label: Commercial-purpose schedule (surcharge %, labor becomes chargeable)
commercial.notes: No commercial-purpose fee schedule or surcharge; the FOIA fee provisions are purpose-blind and 'any person' may request without stating a purpose. waiver.label: Fee waiver: grounds, mandatory vs discretionary, purpose statement, written denial, appeal
waiver.value: mandatory waiver ('shall waive') on five enumerated grounds: (1) indigent requester; (2) records determined exempt under § 1-210(b); (3) compliance benefits the general welfare in the agency's judgment; (4) elected official of the political subdivision obtaining its own agency's record and certifying it pertains to official duties; (5) Division of Public Defender Services member/assigned counsel certifying the record pertains to duties
waiver.unit: enum_list: grounds ×5; mandatory=true (ground 3 rests on agency judgment); purpose statement: only the two certifications; written denial: no fee-specific rule (general § 1-206(a) written-denial rule); appeal: to FOIC within 30 days (§ 1-206(b)(1))
waiver.notes: Not 'defers_to_city' (prior mis-derivation): the waiver duty is statutory and mandatory. fee.copy_rate_per_page.summary: For all public agencies other than state offices/agencies, the fee for a copy of a public record shall not exceed fifty cents per page.
For state executive/administrative/legislative offices and state agencies (and judicial offices in their administrative functions), the copy fee shall not exceed twenty-five cents per page.

fee.electronic_media_charge.summary: The fee for a copy of computer-stored public records shall not exceed the agency's cost, and (for non-preexisting printouts) may include only enumerated components: employee hourly salary for producing/formatting/programming (not search/retrieval except sub-(4)), outside copying-service cost, act…

fee.certified_copy_charge.summary: For certifying a copy of records/files (or certifying a fact appearing therein), the fee is one dollar for the first page and fifty cents for each additional page.

fee.nonstandard_rate.summary: Where a copy requires a transcription, or a person requests a transcription of a public record, the transcription fee shall not exceed the agency's cost.

payment.advance_payment.summary: A public agency may require prepayment of any fee if the fee is estimated to be ten dollars or more.
